question.query: What does a Kestrel K2 scanner cost per unit when we order 50 or more?

passage.title: Price update, March 2026
passage.text: Price update. From March 2, 2026, the Kestrel K2 handheld scanner costs $385 per unit for orders of 50 or more, down from $410. Prices for 1 to 9 and 10 to 49 units are unchanged.

reference.answer: A Kestrel K2 handheld scanner costs $385 per unit when you order 50 or more.
